title: Open an Existing Project
trigger: User wants to work on a previous project

steps.action: On Home, click a project in the Recents list, or click Open Project to browse for a folder
If opening a folder for the first time, the native OS folder picker appears
If the folder is a git repository with no worktree yet, a dialog offers to create a worktree for the cluster or work in the project folder as-is
The project opens in the cluster, with the File Explorer ready and the project path showing in terminals

outcome: Project folder is open in the cluster with File Explorer and terminal ready
